issue.title: feat(game): add a difficulty picker
issue.body:
### User story

As a player, I want to pick a difficulty, so that new players aren't scared off.

### Acceptance criteria

- **Given** the home screen, **when** I tap Play, **then** I see Easy, Medium and Hard.
- **Given** Hard, **when** a run starts, **then** words come from `src/data/words/` hard tier.

### Market impact

_No response_

### Details

Screens: `design/screens/home.png`. Logic in src/game/config.ts and src/game/engine.ts. Follows #10 and https://github.com/RosePinkDragon/fuzzy-waddle/pull/28. Not other/repo#3 or https://github.com/other/repo/issues/9. Uses `type/<issue>-name` branches and node 22.1.0.

### Priority

P2 - should have

### Estimate

S (half a day)
